Unlike stocks or other volatile investments, where you can just fall flat on your face, real estate is a tangible asset that continues to appreciate while producing steady rental income. The process of building wealth in the long term with real estate does not mean simply buying any house and renting it out.

Real estate is a better long-term investment if you have a strategy, market knowledge, and patience to maximize your returns. In this blog, we will guide you through practical tips and proven strategies for investing in rental properties, laying a solid foundation for long-term success.

## **Key Takeaways**

title: Rental Property Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth with Smart Strategies
text:
# Rental Property Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth with Smart Strategies — Content

* Rental property investment offers passive income, tax advantages, and appreciating assets, making it an extremely effective means of generating wealth for financial stability.
* Essential factors, such as market research, finance, management, and legal advice, are necessary before purchasing an investment property.
* Rental properties are said to offer tax benefits and income, but with risks like difficult-to-deal-with tenants and rising costs.
* Airbnb's success relies on selecting the correct location, maintaining the property in good condition, and implementing effective financial and legal planning.
* Maximizing ROI is a case of intelligent location selection, cost evaluation, renovation, and open lease terms that draw consistent renters.
* Avoiding pitfalls like under-budgeting for costs, poor location selection, and over-renovation saves your rental investments.

## **What Is Rental Property Investing And Why Does It Work?**

title: Rental Property Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth with Smart Strategies
text:
# Rental Property Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth with Smart Strategies — Content

Rental property investing is a long-term wealth-building approach, using the "buy and hold" technique. It involves acquiring a property and keeping it for the long term to earn two major sources of profit, regular rental income and the natural appreciation of the property's value over time. When the property value appreciates, investors earn rental income and equity, ultimately resulting in enormous profits when the asset is sold.

A key reason this model works so well is leverage; using borrowed money like a mortgage to buy the property. Paying rent is building your mortgage pay-off, which adds to your equity (ownership) in the property. Over time, the increasing equity allows you to refinance and invest again in additional properties, thereby building your portfolio.

Another method to achieve success is to reinvest rental income; but using it to improve the property, pay off debt faster, or save for more investments. This builds a strong, stable portfolio that can ride out market fluctuations.

title: Rental Property Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth with Smart Strategies
text:
# Rental Property Investing: Build Long-Term Wealth with Smart Strategies — Content

Others employ property flipping, in which they purchase undervalued houses, fix them up, and resell at a markup. Flipping is more dangerous, requires more time, but can pay back money more quickly. Combining all these techniques gives a guaranteed formula for long-term wealth through rental property investing.

## **Buying An Investment Property: Key Factors To Consider**

Once you understand how the rental property works, buying the right investment property follows. Here are the factors that can make your investment successful:

* **Market Research:**Conduct market research for high-demand rentals, low vacancy rates, and rising property value areas in the city or emerging neighborhoods.
* **Financial Feasibility:** Make sure rental income will cover all costs of the property, including mortgage, insurance, taxes, and maintenance.
* **Property Management:**Either manage your property yourself or contract a management company. Professional assistance simplifies your work but lowers profits a bit.
* **Tax and Legal Issues:**Understand landlord-tenant law and consult a tax professional to figure out how rental income and expenses will impact your tax returns.

## **Buying An Airbnb Property: Tips For Short-Term Rental Success**

Airbnb investment may be highly profitable, but only if planned wisely. Four things are most crucial:

* **Location:** Select locations with heavy tourist traffic, convenient transport facilities, and minimal competition. Locations near landmark sites or airports optimize occupancy.

* **Short-Term Rentals**: Renting homes on a short-term basis (e.g., Airbnb) offers higher returns but requires active management.

title: The Appeal of Villas for Sale in Marbella: What Buyers Should Know
text:
# The Appeal of Villas for Sale in Marbella: What Buyers Should Know — Content

Spain's income tax rates are generally lower than those in many other European countries, making it an attractive destination for those seeking to minimise their tax burden. Non-residents who become tax residents in Spain can benefit from the "[Beckham Law,](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Beckham_law)" a special tax regime that allows them to be taxed as non-residents for their first six years in the country. This means they pay a flat rate of 24% on their income up to €600,000, with any income exceeding that threshold taxed at 47%.

### **No Wealth Tax in Andalusia**

In a move to attract wealthy individuals and encourage investment, the Andalusian regional government (where Marbella is located) has eliminated wealth tax as of 2023. This means that residents of Andalusia no longer have to pay an annual tax on their worldwide assets, making it an even more attractive location for high-net-worth individuals seeking to establish residency.

### **Golden Visa Program**

title: The Appeal of Villas for Sale in Marbella: What Buyers Should Know
text:
# The Appeal of Villas for Sale in Marbella: What Buyers Should Know — Content

Spain's Golden Visa program is another significant draw for foreign investors. By investing €500,000 or more in real estate, non-EU citizens can obtain a residency visa for themselves and their families. This residency permit allows them to live and work in Spain, as well as travel freely within the Schengen Area. The Golden Visa program has become a popular pathway for those seeking to establish a European base and enjoy the many benefits that Spain has to offer.

### **Other Tax Benefits**

In addition to the above, Spain also offers other tax advantages for residents, such as deductions for mortgage interest payments and property taxes. These benefits can further reduce your overall tax burden and make owning a villa for sale in Marbella an even more attractive proposition.

It's important to consult with a qualified tax advisor to fully understand the tax implications of living in Spain and to ensure you're taking advantage of all available deductions and exemptions. # The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap — Heading + Content

The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap

### How Rail Is Reshaping the Region Into One Connected Market of Opportunity

In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day.

After 13:15, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors and take the keys with him.

Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M — an extraordinary leap in one generation.

But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.

#### The Trains Are Coming

One rail announcement after another is transforming six separate markets into one connected region:

- Riyadh–Doha high-speed rail
~2 hours of travel, 10M+ passengers expected, 30K new jobs, ~$30B in economic impact.

- UAE domestic rail (Etihad Rail)
Linking 11 cities as of 2026. Abu Dhabi to Dubai in 57 minutes, with a future high-speed train cutting that to 30 minutes.

- UAE–Oman corridor (Hafeet Rail)
Connecting Abu Dhabi to Sohar in ~100 minutes, transforming both passenger movement and freight.

title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
text:
# The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap — Content

All of this feeds into the 2,100 km GCC Railway, which by 2030 aims to create a single passenger experience that feels like domestic travel.

#### What This Means for People & Business

When borders become this frictionless, behavior changes. Millions of air passengers now have tempting alternatives.

#### Tourism spreads

- Dubai residents can finish work on Friday and enjoy dinner in Muscat.

- Families in Doha see Riyadh as a two-hour weekend trip.

- Standalone trips evolve into multi-city Gulf experiences.

#### Business accelerates

- Morning meetings in Riyadh, back in Abu Dhabi by afternoon.

- Supply chains reorganize around rail hubs.

- Companies hire across the GCC as commuting replaces relocation.

At this scale, mobility turns the GCC into one integrated economic system — because practically, it becomes one.

#### Early Connectivity Bets That Set the Stage

This vision for interconnectivity was laid down years ago:

- Saudi–Oman highway (2021)
Cut 16 hours of travel through the Empty Quarter.

- King Fahd Causeway (1986)
Linked Saudi Arabia and Bahrain and today moves 30M+ passengers a year.

title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
text:
# The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap — Content

These were early signals of a region thinking and acting as one. What’s different now is scale and timing: complementary systems being built simultaneously, with major links completing within this decade.

#### Design for the Network, Not the Node

For real estate, investment, policy, and beyond, the shift is fundamental. You’re no longer designing for a single location, but for access to an entire connected Gulf of opportunity.

This aligns with DarGlobal’s Live All In philosophy: living across markets and borders, supported by a level of connectivity that’s actively under construction.

If this is how far the GCC has already travelled, imagine what the next chapter holds.

In times like this, you either get on board — or watch the train leave without you.

title: The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap
text:
# The Trains Are Coming: The GCC's Next Connectivity Leap — Description

In the late 1960s, Dubai Airport used to operate from 07:00 to 13:00, handling just a few hundred passengers a day. After 13:00, the airport manager (more like a caretaker) would lock the doors at 13:15 and take the keys with him. Today, Dubai moves more than 90M passengers a year, Abu Dhabi around 30M, and Doha over 50M - and extraordinary leap in one generation. But as transformative as aviation has been for opening the Gulf to the world, the region is now entering a new era of mobility, driven by land connections within the GCC.

text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Heading + Content

Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas

Have you ever had that feeling of entering into a space and getting completely relaxed, motivated, or revitalized? It's the lighting, as it can completely change the room's atmosphere and make it more beautiful and comforting.

For example, we combine traditional Arabic lighting design seamlessly with advanced technologies at Omani luxury developments like [AIDA Oman](https://darglobal.co.uk/landing-page/aida) properties. This results in interiors that reflect Omani tradition while offering modern comfort and ambiance. So, let’s examine the different types of lighting in interior design best suited to Oman’s unique residential complexes.

## **Understanding the Role of Lighting in Interior Design**

There is a reason why lighting is at the center of any interior space, especially within Oman's unique architectural form. Let’s have a look:

### **1. Sets Up The Mood And Ambience**

In Omani houses, receiving guests and hosting are part of the culture. Therefore they incorporate warm, golden lighting from old-fashioned lanterns and smart lights to make their home feel more welcoming and at peace.

### **2. Establishes Space and Function**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

Every room in a home is used for a different reason, and the lighting must serve that. The kitchen, for example, needs focused task lighting, particularly over countertops and cooking areas. In Omani interiors, defining space with light is especially effective in open floor plans. Light may direct flow, define zones, and provide visual separation without physical barriers.

### **3. Affects Perception of the Space**

Architectural Details in Oman, such as intricate wall carvings or mosaic tiles, are highlighted by lighting, giving the space depth and drama. Even the selection of fixtures like ornate, minimalist, or traditional impacts the perception of a room. It is for this reason that knowledge of the sorts of lighting involved in interior design is important, especially in upscale Omani homes.

## **Popular Types of Lighting Used in Omani Interiors**

The essence of Omani home architecture is its capacity to blend tradition with innovation. Here are the types of lighting used in the interiors of Oman's luxury villas and homes.

### **1. Chandeliers**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

Chandeliers are a time-honored favorite and the pièce de résistance of most Omani decor, especially in the majlis or grand entrances. These lights are often highlighted by Arabic motifs or hand-detailed work that respects classical craftsmanship. Crystal chandeliers let you enjoy classic refinement, whereas contemporary versions help you boost your geometric motifs in brass or gold finishes.

Apart from aesthetics, chandeliers are also a primary source of light that instantly adds aura to any space. Whether an antique Moroccan piece or a minimalist modern design, the chandelier is a favorite in Omani luxury design.

### **2. Recessed Lighting**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

Clean, discreet, and highly utilitarian, recessed lighting is ideal for new Omani residences. It is often used in living rooms, bedrooms, and kitchens to add even, soft lighting. Recessed lighting keeps appearances clean while delivering great lighting, particularly in properties with lower ceilings or minimalist aesthetics. We at DarGlobal prefer recessed lighting to quietly emphasize architectural elements such as ceiling coves, built-in bookshelves, or textured walls. This type of lighting creates a layered effect that seems both refined and welcoming.

### **3. Pendant Lights**

Pendant lights are especially chic above dining tables, kitchen counters, or reading areas. Oman pendant lights commonly combine traditional and contemporary elements such as perforated metal shades or handblown glass with Arabic calligraphy. Their versatility allows designers to play with scale and composition. Clusters of small pendants can create a dramatic impact, while a single oversized piece can be a statement in minimalist interiors.

### **4. Wall Sconces**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

Omani houses use wall sconces extensively to add warmth and personality to hallways, bathrooms, and sidewalls of larger spaces. Frequently they feature Arabic lighting design elements such as lattice details or colored glass. They may supplement existing lighting fixtures or add personality as standalone decor. Sconces offer a great way to light up certain details, like paintings or architectural details, introducing multiple dimensions of depth and interest.

### **5. LED Strip Lighting**

LED strip lights are a modern feature that combines functionality with visual beauty. They are often placed underneath the kitchen cabinets, in rear of bathroom mirrors, or along ceiling soffits to provide ambient illumination. Their energy efficiency and versatility make them a darling in luxury Oman home designs, especially in developments that seek sustainability without sacrificing aesthetics.

## **Arabic Lighting Design: Blending Tradition with Modernity**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

The heritage of Arabic culture is profoundly rooted in the architecture and interior design of Omani. Arabic lighting design transcends that heritage by embracing ornate designs, warm colors, and handmade craftsmanship. In modern houses, such a traditional look is being reinvented. Designers today combine these in minimal forms and cutting-edge lighting technologies to appeal to contemporary tastes without sacrificing cultural identity.

An example would be a classic Moroccan-type lantern equipped with intelligent lighting capabilities or low-power LEDs. This symbiotic fusion of old and new can be observed in our projects in Oman, such as [The Great Escape 2](https://darglobal.co.uk/the-great-escape-2-aida-oman) and [Fairway Villas](https://darglobal.co.uk/fairway-villas-aida-oman), which smoothly merge these customs into their contemporary luxury designs, resulting in nostalgic and effective interiors.

## **Best Lighting Choices for Different Areas of Omani Homes & Villas**

Each area of an Omani home requires a unique lighting solution that balances function, form, and cultural context. Here's what works best:

### **Majlis (Guest Reception Area)**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

Traditional chandeliers and wall sconces bring a sense of grandeur and hospitality, and they are perfect for welcoming guests in legit Omani style.

### **Living Room**

Place recessed lighting for ambient illumination and floor lamps for cozy reading or conversation nooks.

### **Dining**

Use a pendant or statement chandelier right above your dining table. This will add intimacy and elegance to every meal.

### **Bedrooms**

Get warm ambient lighting along with stylish bedside lamps. This makes your personal space comfortable and relaxed for a restful night.

### **Kitchen**

Opt for task lighting over work areas and under-cabinet LED strips for function and ambiance.

### **Bathrooms**

Choose vanity lights that provide illumination for grooming. To ensure safety and functionality, you can also use moisture-resistant recessed lights.

### **Hallways & Corridors**

Utilize wall sconces or motion-sensor LED lights to ensure safety and enhance architectural interest.

### **Outdoor Spaces (Courtyard/Garden)**

Get lantern-style and solar path lights to enhance visibility while embracing traditional Omani aesthetics.

## **Lighting Tips for Enhancing Oman House Design Aesthetics**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

If you wish to take your Omani house design to the next level, adopt these five lighting tips to enhance your aesthetics.

### **1. Layer Your Lighting**

Avoid relying on one source of light, especially when you can mix ambient, task, and recessed lighting to add depth in each room. For example, in your living room, you can have recessed lights, floor lamps, and LED strips for a contemporary flair.

### **2. Employ Dimmers for Flexibility**

Dimmers let you control light levels based on the time of day, activity, or your mood. This is especially useful in areas such as the majlis or bedroom.

### **3. Emphasize Traditional Elements**

Use recessed lighting to showcase culturally important elements like carved wooden doors, mosaic tiling, or Arabic calligraphy, etc.. Wall sconces or LED spotlights can be used to draw attention to these beautiful elements.

### **4. Add Warm Tones**

Warm lighting (2700K to 3000K) pairs well with earthy color palettes and organic materials that are popular in Omani interiors. It evokes feelings of hospitality and comfort, which are both core to the Omani lifestyle.

### **5. Balance Natural & Artificial Light**

title: Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas
text:
# Best Types of Lighting in Interior Design for Omani Homes & Villas — Content

Optimize Oman's rich sunshine by creating spaces with abundant natural light. Blend artificial lighting that complements without competing with it, such as using reflective surfaces or sheer curtains to diffuse light elegantly.

## **Conclusion**

The kind of lighting used in the interior design in your house can not only affect how your space looks but also how it lives and feels. Be it an ethereal chandelier in your majlis, or a task light in your kitchen, or subtle wall sconces leading your way through the corridor, all you need are perfect lights to turn your home into an extraordinary space from an ordinary one.

These houses don't simply light up, they narrate in light. Ready to light up your life Omani style? Unravelling the luxuries of Costa del Sol: Best Things to Do & Places to Visit

If you have packed your bags with no destination in mind, prepare yourself to get a first-class ticket to one of the world’s most luxurious havens, the coast of the sun, Costa del Sol. It is a long stretch of Mediterranean coastline in southern Spain’s Andalusia region.

It is where luxury is a tradition, and nature is the standard beauty. Its impeccable nature provides a delicate mixture of elegance and comfort, tradition, and avant-garde. From Marbella’s extravagant nightlife to Benahavis’s quiet and isolated countryside and Malaga’s sandy beaches, let us invite you to see why you will purchase a one-way ticket to Costa del Sol.

**Best things to do in Costa del Sol:**

text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Heading + Content

Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates

Spain's Golden Visa scheme is among the most alluring and convenient ways to get a residency visa in Europe, allowing people outside the EU to stay, work, and move without any restrictions in the Schengen Zone. If you are looking for a "Golden visa in Spain" or simply considering an investment route to gain a resident permit in Europe, all the information is here in this guide.

## **Key Takeaways**

title: Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates
text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Content

* A minimum real estate investment of €500,000 with total costs ranging from €530,000 to €560,000, including fees, taxes, legal expenses, health insurance, and documentation requirements.
* Travel visas are free to 27 Schengen countries with no minimum stay requirements and you only need to visit Spain once a year to keep your residency.
* An inclusive package for the whole family consisting of the husband, dependent children, and parents, with all members enjoying equal rights to work and study throughout Spain.
* A well-defined route to permanent residence after five years and Spanish citizenship after ten years of legal residence and meeting integration requirements.
* A quick turnaround of less than a month with a straightforward application via Spanish consulates, which requires health insurance, a clean criminal record, and proof of legitimate investment funds.

## **What is Spain's Golden Visa?**

title: Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates
text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Content

The Spain Golden Visa is one way to give a non-European Union citizen the right to stay indefinitely in Spain if they make a substantial investment in the country. It started in 2013 and has been allowing the investors and their families to get a residence visa that can be renewed without their actual presence in Spain. Additionally, it opens up an opportunity to live in Europe by buying properties, starting up a business, or making money deposits, providing flexibility in living and easy travel in the Schengen Area of Europe with no need for a visa.

## **Spain Golden Visa Requirements & Eligibility**

To confirm whether you can get a golden visa in Spain, the following conditions must be fulfilled:

* First of all, you should be a person who is not a citizen of the European Union, the European Economic Area, or Switzerland and who is over 18 years of age.
* You should not have been convicted of any crime.
* You have to hold valid private health insurance.
* You should have the necessary financial resources available to you.
* Not to be illegally present in Spain.

## **Investment Options Detailed Analysis**

title: Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates
text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Content

**Real Estate Investment:** Buying a property valued at least €500,000 is the most standard way, which makes it possible for investors to acquire either one or multiple real estate properties.

**Capital Investment:** Make an investment of €1 million in shares of a Spanish company or bank deposits, or €2 million in government bonds.

**Business Project:** Prepare a business plan that will be beneficial for Spain in general, be a source of employment, or be a contributor to innovation.

## **Complete Cost Breakdown**

How much does a golden visa in Spain cost? The next point to consider is:

* **Property investment:** €500,000 minimum
* **Legal fees:** €3,000–€6,000
* **Property transfer tax:** 6–10%
* **Application fees:** €60–€80 per applicant
* **Health insurance:**€500–€1,500 annually
* **Translation and notarization:** €500–€1,000

Total expenses usually range between €530,000 and €560,000.

## **Benefits of Spain Golden Visa**

title: Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates
text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Content

* Travel without a visa through 27 Schengen countries.
* You can stay as long as you want (visit once per year)
* Ability to extend the residency up to two years, then up to five years.
* Your family, including your spouse, children, and parents, can be part of the program.
* Right to use the Spanish healthcare services and attend schools.
* Process of getting a permanent residence after five years
* Opportunity of getting nationality after 10 years.

## **Family Inclusion and Dependent Requirements**

The Golden Visa is also valid for your wife or husband, children who depend on the family and are under 18 years of age (or older if they are students), and parents who depend on you. They are given equal rights as residents, but they have to comply with the criteria of having their own health insurance and undergoing background checks.

## **Application Process: Step-by-Step Guide**

Understanding how to apply for a golden visa in Spain:

title: Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates
text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Content

1. Make the necessary investment that qualifies you.
2. Get NIE (tax identification number)
3. Get a health insurance policy.
4. Prepare the necessary documentation.
5. File an application at the consulate in Spain or locally in Spain.
6. Go to a biometric data collection center.
7. Wait for the decision(usually 20 working days)
8. Collect a residence card.

## **Required Documents Checklist**

* Photocopies of a valid passport
* Application forms that are completely filled out
* Certificate of no criminal record (apostilled)
* A policy of private health insurance
* Document confirming the investment
* Health certificate
* Marriage and birth certificates

## **Recent Updates and Changes (2025)**

The golden visa regulations in Spain as of 2025 are still beneficial to investors. The authorities have kept the €500,000 real estate investment threshold but have also improved the security checks and raised the standards for paperwork. The waiting period has significantly decreased, most of the cases being closed within one month.

## **Tax Implications and Obligations**

title: Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates
text:
# Golden Visa in Spain: Eligibility, Cost & Recent Updates — Content

People with a Golden Visa who live in Spain for less than 183 days per year are considered non-residents for tax purposes and are only liable for the income generated in Spain. If you go beyond this limit, you will become a tax resident and will be taxed on your global income. Get advice from a Spanish tax professional to make the best use of your structure.

What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs

Property insurance shall be considered one of the essential purchases that help to secure your real estate assets against any risk. Still, many property owners find it hard to understand how the insurers set the premiums and what causes the changes. No matter if you are the first owner of a house or an experienced investor, getting to the bottom of property insurance premiums can be a great money-saving tool for you, besides providing the right amount of coverage.

Everything about property insurance premiums, including the calculations and the cost reduction strategies, is now fully explained in this guide.

## **Key Takeaways:**

title: What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs
text:
# What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs — Content

* The amount of property insurance that you will be charged is connected to the risk factors that are considered, such as place, the value of the property, the materials from which the property is made and the limits of the coverage.
* $1,200 to $2,500 per year property insurance will cost for homeowners
* The insurance premium for commercial properties is usually between 0.25% and 0.75% of the replacement value.
* Under certain conditions, the mortgage insurance premium for a rental property may be allowed as a tax deduction.
* Strategic planning can reduce premiums by 15 - 30%.

## **What Is Property Insurance Premium?**

A property insurance premium is a yearly amount that you pay to an insurance company for a policy that protects your real estate investment against various risks like fire, theft, and natural disasters. It is the cost of your financial protection plan.

The premium is your share of a risk pool, where insurance companies gather money from property owners and then use the collected funds to compensate for losses after a disaster. Your particular premium expresses a combination of the risk profile of your property and the selected coverage level.

title: What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs
text:
# What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs — Content

## **How Is Property Insurance Premium Calculated?**

It enables you to understand the topic of property insurance premium calculation that will help you make efficient coverage decisions. The insurance companies employ a set of algorithms that consider a whole range of risk factors.

### **Primary Calculation Factors:**

**Property Location Risk:**Where you live has a major impact on the cost you have to pay for your insurance. Places that are at risk of suffering from hurricanes, earthquakes, floods or have high crime rates will have to pay more. To identify the areas where the risk is, insurance companies rely on the weather trends and the history of claims made in the area.

**Property Characteristics:**The age of the house, its size, the materials used for construction, and the architectural features are among the factors that have a direct impact on the calculations. Typically, a house that has been recently built with materials that are resistant to fire will be assigned a lower premium than an old property.

title: What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs

# What is Property Insurance Premium: Definition, Calculation Methods, and Average Costs — Content

**Coverage and Deductibles:**Insuring for higher coverage limits will raise the insurance premiums, whereas a higher deductible will bring them down. By comparing various combinations, one can identify the best cost-benefit ratios.

**Claims History:**Your personal insurance history and any claims filed on the property impact the insurance premium.

**Credit Score:**In various states, Credit scores are one of the factors that insurance companies look at when they set the rates.

## **Average Property Insurance Costs**

The prices for property insurance differ significantly from one region to another, as well as between different types of properties and levels of coverage. Having a general idea of insurance rates enables you to evaluate your premiums and save money.

The prices of the properties in your local area, the laws in your state, the building standards, and the competitiveness of the housing market all contribute to the average prices in your area.

## **Commercial Property Insurance Premium**

Insurance premiums for commercial real estate are handled differently from those for residential homes, which reflect the specific risks and the fact that business properties usually have higher values.

**Typical Ranges:**The majority of commercial properties are insured with premiums from 0.25% to 0.75% of the replacement value per year. Moreover, companies such as those in the high-risk industries may get charged with premiums of more than 1%.

**Risk Factors:**The way a business is run has a significant impact on the insurance premiums. Factories have different risk factors as compared to office buildings, while eateries have their own unique fire exposure.

"Is mortgage insurance premium tax-deductible for rental property?" is one of those questions that come up regularly among real estate investors.

Property insurance gives the owner full value that is over and above financial security:

Owning a house near the water was considered the ultimate goal of real estate. ## **Key Takeaways**

title: Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential
text:
# Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential — Content

* Waterfront real estates that are directly adjacent to water bodies with immediate shoreline access are known to have 30-150% higher prices than those of comparable inland properties.
* Among these, oceanfront properties are the ones that have the highest premiums (100%+), followed by lakefront (40-60%) and riverfront (25-40%) locations.
* The top investment destinations are the French Riviera, the Caribbean, Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Oman and Qatar, which are offering a strong potential for appreciation.
* There are some additional costs that buyers need to be aware of, such as elevated flood insurance, 1.5 to 2 times higher maintenance expenses, and increased property taxes.
* On the other hand, the investment benefits are, among others, consistent above market appreciation, a strong potential for rental income, and a hedge against inflation due to limited supply.

## **What is Waterfront Property?**

title: Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential
text:
# Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential — Content

Waterfront property refers to real estate that is situated right next to a water body and thus, has unmediated access to the shore. Such properties cover areas where living spaces or estates are located alongside seas, lakes, rivers, canals, or bays. The main factor that differentiates waterfront properties is the direct touch or contact with water, not merely seeing it from afar.

Real waterfront properties have the privilege of a personal water connection, which can be through a beach, a pier, or the direct shore. Such a difference dramatically affects the worth of the property as well as the owner's way of life.

## **Types of Waterfront Properties**

**Oceanfront Properties:** Those are the ones that are literally on the beach and have access to the beach, and they usually cost the most money.

**Lakefront Homes:** Real estate surrounding clean and pure lakes that allow the owners to build docks for themselves and also enjoy the tranquillity of the waters.

**Riverfront Estates:** Residences built on rivers that have views of running water and access to the water for navigation.

title: Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential
text:
# Waterfront Property: Definition, Value & Investment Potential — Content

**Canalfront Properties:** These are the ones that provide access to the waterway, as well as private boat slips.

## **Waterfront Property Value Premium Analysis**

How much does waterfront add to property value?Usually, waterfront properties will cost 30% to 150% more than equivalent non-waterfront properties, the main factors determining the difference being the location and the water type.

Seaside properties are the ones that are the most expensive; their extra cost is, therefore, frequently double or even more than that of similar properties. In contrast, the value of a property exposed to a lake only rises by 40 to 60%, while a property on the bank of a river is worth 25 to 40% more.

## **Waterfront Property Pricing and Cost Analysis**

How much does waterfront property cost? Prices can be very different at different places. For example, oceanfront properties in luxury markets can cost anywhere between $2 million and more than $50 million, whereas lakefront homes in the less expensive areas may be available for half a million dollars.

## **A Glimpse into Muscat's Rich Heritage**

Muscat's history is as rich and diverse as its landscape. Founded over 2,000 years ago, the city has been a thriving centre of trade and culture for centuries. Its strategic location on the ancient maritime Silk Road made it a melting pot of civilizations, with influences from Arabia, Persia, India, and Africa.

# Your Ultimate Guide to Buying Luxury Villas in Muscat — Content

Today, remnants of this rich past can be found throughout the city. The imposing forts of Al Jalali and Al Mirani stand guard over the harbour, while the Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque, a masterpiece of modern Islamic architecture, showcases Oman's deep-rooted faith and cultural heritage. Stroll through the Muttrah Souq, a labyrinthine maze of shops selling spices, incense, textiles, and handicrafts, and you'll feel transported back in time.

## **A Natural Wonderland: Muscat's Diverse Landscape**

Muscat's allure extends far beyond its rich history and cultural tapestry. It is a city blessed with a breathtaking natural landscape that is as diverse as it is captivating.

From rugged mountain ranges to pristine beaches and enchanting deserts, Muscat offers a wealth of natural wonders that will leave you awe-inspired.

### **The Hajar Mountains: Majestic Guardians of Muscat**

Dominating the skyline, the Al Hajar Mountains rise majestically, their peaks piercing the sky and casting long shadows across the land. This rugged mountain range, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is a haven for outdoor enthusiasts, offering opportunities for hiking, rock climbing, and camping.

title: Your Ultimate Guide to Buying Luxury Villas in Muscat

Venture into the heart of the mountains and discover a world of hidden valleys, terraced fields, and ancient villages. Explore the scenic trails of Wadi Bani Awf, a deep gorge carved by centuries of flowing water, or witness the breathtaking beauty of Jebel Akhdar, the "Green Mountain," with its terraced gardens, rose plantations, and fruit orchards.

### **The Arabian Sea: A Playground for Water Enthusiasts**

Muscat's coastline, stretching for miles along the Arabian Sea, is a paradise for water lovers. The city boasts a variety of beaches, each with its own unique charm.

From the bustling shores of Qurum Beach, where you can try your hand at water sports and enjoy a lively atmosphere, to the secluded coves of Bandar Jissah, where you can relax in tranquillity and soak up the sun, there's a beach for every mood and occasion.

Venture beyond the city limits and you'll encounter the vast expanse of the Arabian Desert. This mystical landscape of shifting sands, sculpted by the wind into mesmerising patterns, is a testament to the raw power and beauty of nature.

The Nomination Committee assists the Board in discharging its responsibilities relating to the composition and make-up of the Board and any committees of the Board. title: Investor Relations
text:
# Investor Relations — Corporate Governance

The Remuneration Committee assists the Board in determining its responsibilities in relation to directors’ remuneration, including making recommendations to the Board on the Company’s policy on executive remuneration, including setting the over-arching principles, parameters and governance framework of the Group’s remuneration policy and determining the individual remuneration and benefits package of each of the Executive Directors and senior management (including fees paid to the Company Secretary). The Remuneration Committee will give due regard to the provisions and recommendations in the Corporate Governance Code when determining the remuneration policy. The Remuneration Committee will be chaired by Richard Stockdale and its other members will be David Weinreb and Maurice Horan.
Audit And Risk Committee

title: Investor Relations
text:
# Investor Relations — Corporate Governance

The Audit and Risk Committee assists the Board in discharging its responsibilities with regard to financial reporting, external and internal audits and controls, including reviewing and monitoring the integrity of the Group’s annual and interim financial statements, reviewing and monitoring the extent of the non-audit work undertaken by external auditors, advising on the appointment of external auditors, overseeing the Group’s relationship with its external auditors, reviewing the effectiveness of the external audit process, and reviewing the effectiveness of the Group’s internal audit, internal controls, risk management, whistleblowing and anti fraud systems. The ultimate responsibility for reviewing and approving the annual report and accounts and the half-yearly reports remains with the Board. The Audit and Risk Committee will be chaired by Maurice Horan and its other members will be David Weinreb and Richard Stockdale.

**24 September 2023**: On the seafront terrace belonging to the swanky Marbella beach club La Cabane, the scene for one night only is wall-to-wall Dolce & Gabbana. From the supersized sofas and poolside beds to the attire of many of the conspicuously wealthy guests, it’s a busy vision in what lovers of the fashion brand will recognise as “Maiolica”, its distinctive patterned design.

These ultra-high-net-worths aren’t here to buy clothes, though. They are waiting to put their name down for Europe’s first Dolce & Gabbana residences, which are due to be completed in 2026. “This very special project, this very special experience, is the new Dolce & Gabbana lifestyle in Marbella,” says Domenico Dolce, one half of the world-famous fashion duo. A diminutive, bespectacled and soft-spoken figure dressed entirely in black, he is swamped by prospective buyers.

title: partners
text:
# partners — Collab Data

“The location is crucial and this is one of the best areas in Spain. But we made sure we didn’t rush into choosing a developer. We need to be very careful as we need to protect the asset,” says Alfonso Dolce, Domenico’s younger brother and the company’s chief executive, who has been visiting Marbella for 23 years.

Alfonso adds that D&G and Sierra Blanca Estates, which has been building on the coast since 1985 (the same year, coincidentally, that the fashion house launched), share a deep bond. “We are both family-run companies, and we share two important things: family and passion,” he says. With the Marbella project, he adds, “we are giving a whole lifestyle, not just a building. We don’t need to sell fast.”

For the super-rich keen for the ego boost — and potential profit — that comes with being one of the first buyers, that message may fall on deaf ears.

**Riyadh, KSA; October 6, 2021:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns.

The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks two significant firsts for both the companies: DarGlobal’s regional expansion with its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and the Arab world’s first ever bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces designed by the fashion brand’s MissoniHome line dedicated to interiors, decor, and furnishings.

Urban Oasis is situated in the heart of the city directly on the Dubai Water Canal in close proximity to Downtown Dubai’s top attractions such as Burj Khalifa and The Dubai Mall, and many other premium lifestyle locations. The deluxe homes of Urban Oasis offer spectacular and uninterrupted views of the Dubai Water Canal, making the tower a true urban oasis within the bustling city.

Construction of the tower is currently underway and is set to be completed before the end of 2023.

**Dubai, UAE; March 24, 2022:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the GCC, and Oman Tourism Development Company (OMRAN Group) – the executive arm of the Sultanate for tourism development, have signed an agreement recently at Expo 2020 Dubai to develop ‘AIDA’, one of the largest premium, mixed-use real estate projects located in the Yiti area in Muscat.

The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Oman to drive the development of the property market and support the growth of Oman’s real-estate sector in accordance with Oman Vision 2040. The value of the investment in the project from both parties will reach SR6 billion, and it will be developed in three stages on an area of 3.5 million square metres.

**Dubai, UAE; October 6, 2022:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Italian Hypercar manufacturer Pagani Automobili, unveiled the first apartment at the magnificent DaVinci tower located in Downtown Dubai. The apartment, a residential masterpiece, gave prospective buyers a glimpse into the world’s first-ever Pagani-inspired exclusive space as well as the uniqueness of the Da Vinci tower’s apartment portfolio.

Reflecting the cornerstone of Horacio Pagani’s creative philosophy that combines form and function to create unique, handmade objects, all 80 apartments will be adorned with tailored pieces from the line of Pagani branded furniture. This, combined with a blend of high-end marble and wooden flooring dotted with chevron patterns, doors bearing the Pagani emblem, and custom lighting, is nothing short of captivating.

The three-bedroom apartment redefines the dimensions of space for those looking to make Dubai their home. It also demonstrated a unique confluence of Italian and contemporary design excellence that is slated to characterise the entire inventory, epitomising Pagani’s craftmanship and emphasising the concept of Living Above Luxury.

DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects unveil premium sea-front residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB at Expo 2020 Dubai

* The Qatar Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai hosted the launch of the premium residential project that marks Saudi Arabia’s DarGlobal’s entry into the Qatari market
* Inspired by the sea and luxury island living, Les Vagues residences embody the sophisticated elegance of ELIE SAAB designs

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Dubai, UAE; March 23, 2022:** The Qatar Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai hosted the launch of Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB, a luxury residential project that’s being developed by DarGlobal, the leading real-estate company in Saudi Arabia, and Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality.

title: press/dar-al-arkan-and-qetaifan-projects-unveil-premium-sea-front-residences-with-interiors-designed-by-elie-saab-at-expo-2020-dubai
text:
# press/dar-al-arkan-and-qetaifan-projects-unveil-premium-sea-front-residences-with-interiors-designed-by-elie-saab-at-expo-2020-dubai — Description

The exclusive residences by the world-renowned designer reflect the sophisticated elegance and exceptional detailing that ELIE SAAB is recognised for in fashion and lifestyle, setting new standards for modern luxury living in Qatar. Taking inspiration from the unimaginable beauty and serenity of the sea, grand shores, and infinite horizons surrounding Qetaifan Island North, Les Vagues, which means waves in French, have been exquisitely designed as an ode to luxury island life with clean and contemporary lines softened by carefully selected palms and tropical foliage.

# press/dar-al-arkan-and-qetaifan-projects-unveil-premium-sea-front-residences-with-interiors-designed-by-elie-saab-at-expo-2020-dubai — Description

**Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said**, “We’re extremely honored to be launching this prestigious project from Qatar’s Pavilion at Expo 2020 Dubai – it’s truly a significant moment as DarGlobal enters Qatar with a project that will set new standards for luxury living and affirms our commitment to the market. After our successful project launch with the master of design himself, Elie Saab, in Riyadh we’re collaborating for a second time on this premium residential project in one of the region’s most sought-after developments. Our project on Qetaifan Island North is unique and builds on the DarGlobal’s strategic aspirations of regional and global expansion through superior, high-quality real-estate projects that cater to discerning clientele from across the world.”

**Elie Saab Jr, CEO of ELIE SAAB Group, commented:** “We are delighted to collaborate with DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects on this premium residential project that is inspired by the natural beauty of the island and its magnificent surroundings. Les Vagues is a project that embodies architectural and lifestyle expression of our brand delivering exceptional and timeless experiences through luxury real-estate projects that are unmatched globally.”

# press/dar-al-arkan-and-qetaifan-projects-unveil-premium-sea-front-residences-with-interiors-designed-by-elie-saab-at-expo-2020-dubai — Description

**HE Sheikh Nasser Bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Managing Director, Qetaifan Projects, said:** “Following our concerted efforts to provide the local market with international standards that work on developing and revitalizing sectors such as tourism, hospitality, entertainment and of course real estate development, we are happy to bring a new innovative project to Qatar. We’re looking forward to working with DarGlobal and ELIE SAAB, a global pioneer in design, on this premium project that is unlike any other in the region. Qetaifan Island North is being developed as the first touristic entertainment destination in Qatar, that will put the country on the regional and global tourism map, and Les Vagues residences is an integral project within the masterplan of the development.”

Les Vagues feature opulent one, two and three-bedroom sea-front residencies with a variety of majestic balconies and terraces and floor-to ceiling windows for residents to enjoy uninterrupted panoramic views of the sea.

title: press/dar-al-arkan-and-qetaifan-projects-unveil-premium-sea-front-residences-with-interiors-designed-by-elie-saab-at-expo-2020-dubai
text:
# press/dar-al-arkan-and-qetaifan-projects-unveil-premium-sea-front-residences-with-interiors-designed-by-elie-saab-at-expo-2020-dubai — Description

The interiors perfectly embody the beauty of ELIE SAAB’s designs, leaving a lasting impression of refined elegance and spectacular grace where shapes and colors blend harmoniously. Special attention has been given to the finishes with exquisite craftsmanship, exceptional level of quality and aesthetic appeal in pure ELIE SAAB style.

The amenities at Les Vagues are tailored to the residents’ needs, featuring à la carte concierge services as well as a state-of-the-art fitness center, an infinity swimming pool, a landscaped community courtyard with sea views, a 24-hour reception desk, public areas furniture from ELIE SAAB Maison Collection, luxury retail outlets, and parking for all residential units.

DarGlobal and Qetaifan Projects signed the agreement to develop a premium residential and lifestyle project on Qetaifan Island North last October. The project marks DarGlobal’s first entry into Qatar with the aim of driving the development of the luxury property market and support the growth of Qatar’s real-estate sector.

Work on the development will start in Q2 2022, and total sales are expected to reach over 1 billion Qatari Riyal.

title: DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai
text:
# DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai — Heading + Description

DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai

**Riyadh, KSA; 7 June 2022:** DarGlobal is commencing the construction works including the excavation, shoring, and pilling works, 90 days after the successful launch of the W Hotels brand.

**W Residences Dubai –** **Downtown** project in February 2022. The already sold-out 1 billion AED development is anticipated to mark the first standalone residences in the world under the iconic lifestyle W Hotels brand.

The developer signed a contract with Stromek Emirates Foundations (L.L.C) to execute the shoring, excavation and piling works. BHNS Engineering Consultants is the Architect of Records appointed by DarGlobal and will supervise the construction of the enabling package.

title: DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai
text:
# DarGlobal commences construction of the sold-out W Residences in Downtown Dubai — Description

**Ziad El Chaar, Vice Chairman of DarGlobal Properties, said:** “Construction of The W Residences Dubai – Downtown is estimated to be completed by December 2025. This our third project in the Downtown Dubai area after Urban Oasis with Interiors by Missoni and DaVinci Tower with interiors by Pagani and I believe it’s a unique and fulfilling location to own your dream W branded home and our proposition catering to the needs of discerning clientele. Our experience in delivering high-end co-branded homes with global brands like Elie Saab, Versace, Roberto Cavalli, Pagani and Missoni puts us in a unique position to always bring the best, most desirable residential spaces to our customers.

Expanding the DarGlobal brand to international markets is a testament to the success of Saudi companies in delivering unique projects in new markets. The developer is one of the largest publicly listed developers in the Middle East with AED 32 billion in assets and a track record of delivery since 1994.

text:
# press/dar-al-arkan-global-launches-sales-of-the-most-premium-residential-address-in-qatar-les-vagues-by-elie-saab-with-views-of-lusail-skyline-and-the-sea-at-qetaifan-island-north — Description

* The project is a partnership between Qetaifan Projects and DarGlobal in Doha
* Les Vagues are the first ever residences with interiors designed by ELIE SAAB in Qatar
* All residences are first line and have marina promenade views at Qetaifan Island North, Lusail

**Doha, Qatar; 23 October 2022:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has officially launched the sales of Les Vagues residences by ELIE SAAB in Qetaifan Island North, Qatar, in partnership with Qetaifan Projects, a leading Qatari real estate development company fully owned by Katara Hospitality.

Les Vagues by ELIE SAAB, valued at 1 billion Qatari Riyal, sets new standards of luxury living in Qatar with an architectural design that enhances the appeal of seafront living. This premium residential project in Qatar includes one, two, and three-bedroom apartments with terraces offering uninterrupted views of the sea, marina, and Lusail skyline.

The sales launch was announced during an event held in Doha on 19 October in the presence of HE Sheikh Nasser Bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Chairman & Managing Director of Qetaifan Projects, DarGlobal’s Chairman Yousef Al-Shelash, Ziad El Chaar, CEO of DarGlobal Global, and the globally celebrated fashion designer Elie Saab who designed the interiors of the residences.

On this occasion, HE Sheikh Nasser Bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani, Chairman & Managing Director, Qetaifan Projects, said: “The partnership with DarGlobal exemplifies our concerted efforts to make Qetaifan Island North a preferred destination for a global audience, with its unique residential, entertainment, retail, and recreational offerings. With the sales launch of Les Vagues residences, as one of the most premium residential projects on the Island, we anticipate a strong positive response from the local community and international investors, further solidifying Qatar’s position as a global investment.”

title: DarGlobal introduces Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course at its hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman
text:
# DarGlobal introduces Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course at its hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman — Description

**Riyadh, KSA; November 20, 2022:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, and The Trump Organization signed an agreement in New York for the development of a signature Trump Resort, including residential villas, a hotel, and a golf course in the stunning AIDA project. Located in the heart of the capital, Muscat, the 100-meter-high hilltop development is one of the largest premium mixed-use real estate projects in the world, situated directly by the sea. **Yousef Al Shelash, Chairman, DarGlobal, said:** “The Trump Organization is known for its exclusive, world-class developments. Superior quality, detail, and perfection are the standards that Trump demands throughout its projects – from residential to resort, from hotel to golf, and from commercial office to retail.

title: DarGlobal introduces Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course at its hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman
text:
# DarGlobal introduces Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course at its hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman — Description

We are always looking to enhance DarGlobal’s unique projects with premium facilities and experiences, and our partnership with Trump will distinguish our first project in Oman and put it on the global map.” **Eric Trump, Executive Vice President, The Trump Organization, said:** “When we were looking at our next project and where we wanted to expand our footprint, we knew it had to be in an outstanding location and with an amazing team. At AIDA, in the heart of Muscat, Oman situated directly overlooking the incredible sea, we have truly found that. Together with DarGlobal, we are going to deliver an exceptional Trump Golf resort with the finest residential villas, a world-class hotel, and an iconic golf course, all in one of the most beautiful settings.”

title: DarGlobal introduces Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course at its hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman
text:
# DarGlobal introduces Trump signature villas, hotel, and golf course at its hilltop project ‘AIDA’ in Muscat, Oman — Description

**Ziad El Chaar, CEO, DarGlobal, said:** “AIDA sits on a high peak overlooking one of the most breath-taking horizons in the world. Imagine the beautiful setting of a villa in these majestic surroundings or playing a game of golf overlooking the sea – it is truly unrivalled. We are confident the relationship with Trump will enhance the natural beauty of AIDA and attract end-users and investors from around the world looking to be part of an exceptionally iconic project.”

text:
# press/dar-al-arkan-opens-office-in-china-in-a-bid-to-usher-in-global-growth — Heading + Description

DarGlobal opens office in China in a bid to usher in global growth

**Riyadh, KSA; February 5, 2022:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, continues its dynamic growth momentum by announcing the opening of its office in Beijing, China. The announcement is in line with the DarGlobal’s strategic expansion and builds on spreading the leading Saudi Arabian brands globally.

DarGlobal’s Beijing office will serve multiple functions to allow for joint ventures between DarGlobal and leading Chinese real estate developers for the Chinese and the Saudi market, further increasing and facilitate collaboration between Saudi Arabia and China and enhance investment and knowledge sharing opportunities. The office will primarily promote cooperation and partnerships within the real-estate and technology sectors to exchange and implement global best practices in these respective industries.

With this expertise and industry know-how, the company is well-positioned to take this knowledge and creativity to a global level and promote it as best practice. title: Dar al Arkan succeeds in the listing of its international arm, Dar Global on the London stock exchange with a valuation of 2,250,000,000 Saudi Riyals
text:
# Dar al Arkan succeeds in the listing of its international arm, Dar Global on the London stock exchange with a valuation of 2,250,000,000 Saudi Riyals — Heading + Description

Dar al Arkan succeeds in the listing of its international arm, Dar Global on the London stock exchange with a valuation of 2,250,000,000 Saudi Riyals

**RIYADH, February 23rd 2023: Today Dar al Arkan announced the** admission of Dar Global PLC, its independent international development subsidiary, to the Standard Segment of the Official List of the FCA and to the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange. The official direct listing on the London Stock Exchange makes Dar Al Arkan one of the first Saudi homegrown brands to list on the London stock exchange.

Building on the legacy of Dar Al Arkan, the largest real estate company in Saudi Arabia and the region, Dar Global has embarked on a journey to establish a highly differentiated international real estate business predominantly focusing on developing projects comprising luxury second and vacation homes for its global clientele, in some of the most quintessential, handpicked locations across the Middle East and Europe, including downtown Dubai, Qatar, Oman, and London in addition to the Costa del Sol region in Southern Spain.

# DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai — Heading + Description

DarGlobal teams with Missoni to deliver the exclusive Urban Oasis water-front residential tower in Dubai

Urban Oasis by Missoni brings the Missoni lifestyle and Miami vibes to the city

The AED 800 million tower is situated in the heart of the city on the Dubai Water Canal

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Riyadh, KSA; October 6, 2021:** DarGlobal, the leading real estate company in Saudi Arabia, has unveiled the Urban Oasis residential tower in Dubai in partnership with the luxury Italian fashion house, Missoni, known for its bold colours and iconic zigzag motifs, stripes, and wave patterns.

The launch of the prestigious AED 800 million development marks two significant firsts for both the companies: DarGlobal’s regional expansion with its first project in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), and the Arab world’s first ever bespoke Missoni-inspired living spaces designed by the fashion brand’s MissoniHome line dedicated to interiors, decor, and furnishings.

title: Darglobal Reports 17.3% ROE for FY2025
text:
# Darglobal Reports 17.3% ROE for FY2025 — Heading + Description

Darglobal delivers industry-leading 17.3% ROE in 2025, Strengthened position for evolving market conditions

Further to the Full Year Results for 2025 issued on 11 March 2026, Darglobal, the luxury international real estate developer, reports a Return on Equity ('ROE') of 17.3% for the financial year ended 31 December 2025 ('FY25'). This performance places the Group among the highest-returning listed developers in the UK and Europe.

The result reflects the strength of Darglobal's model: a geographically diversified portfolio combined with an asset-light approach that enables disciplined capital deployment while limiting balance sheet exposure.

This model has supported rapid scaling, with the Group's portfolio reaching approximately US$23 billion in GDV, alongside continued expansion into key markets, the launch of new development platforms, and the introduction of asset management capabilities.

Importantly, this performance positions Darglobal to navigate a more uncertain and demanding market environment ahead, with the flexibility, liquidity, and execution discipline required to continue delivering value.

Over the past year, we have scaled the business to a portfolio of US$23 billion in GDV, while maintaining financial discipline and operational efficiency. These results are not only a reflection of past performance, but a clear indication that Darglobal is well-positioned for the market conditions ahead. Our model gives us the flexibility to adapt, the resilience to withstand volatility, and the ability to continue creating long-term value for our stakeholders."*

title: Dar Global advances construction at Tierra Viva, its first European luxury development with Automobili Lamborghini
text:
# Dar Global advances construction at Tierra Viva, its first European luxury development with Automobili Lamborghini — Heading + Description

Dar Global advances construction at Tierra Viva, its first European luxury development with Automobili Lamborghini

Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has commenced infrastructure works for Tierra Viva, its first residential project in continental Europe in collaboration with Automobili Lamborghini. Tierra Viva is situated in the exclusive locality of Benahavis near Marbella, on Spain's south coast, and features 53 grand villas inspired by Lamborghini's iconic design.

This partnership blends Dar Global's expertise in luxury real estate with Lamborghini's renowned design prowess, promising an unparalleled living experience. With the start of the infrastructure work, Dar Global is making real progress towards delivering its distinguished luxury development on time and with the highest standards of quality and competency to maximise long-term value for investors.

Sacyr Construction, one of Spain's leading construction companies, has been awarded the contract to design and build infrastructural works, including laying road, water, and electricity networks around the residential project. Sacyr Construction will also be responsible for developing the surrounding road network.

Working with best-in-class partners adds value to our highly-anticipated residential property as we bring the future of luxury living to an affluent global clientele in Spain. Tierra Viva's design language pays homage to Automobili Lamborghini, marking the brand’s first residential project in Europe that guarantees residents a unique and high-quality lifestyle experience.”

Dar Global Introduces Stunning Beach Residence The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin

Positioned in a pristine location near the highly anticipated Wynn Resort, The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin will bring the carmaker’s signature blend of sophisticated design and high-performance precision craftsmanship to the interiors of the property, promising an unrivalled lifestyle experience for distinguished residents.

title: DarGlobal's Agents Event Debuts in Spanish Real Estate
text:
# DarGlobal's Agents Event Debuts in Spanish Real Estate — Heading + Description

DarGlobal’s Agents Event Paves the Way for a Spectacular Debut in Spanish Real Estate

**Benahavis, Spain – June 1, 2023 :** DarGlobal, the premier luxury real estate developer listed on the London Stock Exchange, announced its official debut in the Spanish market with an inaugural agent briefing event in the ultra-luxurious locale of Benahavis. The briefing event introduced DarGlobal to the key players in the Spanish real estate industry, with agents from over 100 renowned real estate brokerage firms in attendance.

Based on its distinctive heritage, DarGlobal is set to redefine the landscape of Spain’s luxury real estate and second-homes industry. With operations spanning across the United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates, Oman, Qatar, Bosnia, and now Spain, DarGlobal has carved out a reputation for its distinguished projects worldwide. Among these are the iconic Urban Oasis Tower by Missoni and DaVinci Tower by Pagani in Dubai, Les Vagues residences by Elie Saab in Doha, the serene SIDRA residences in Bosnia, and the illustrious AIDA master development in Oman, home to a Trump Golf Club, hotel, and residences. These developments testify to DarGlobal’s commitment to excellence and innovative design, setting high expectations for their forthcoming ventures in Spain.

title: DarGlobal's Expansion into Saudi Arabia: Real Estate Opportunities
text:
# DarGlobal's Expansion into Saudi Arabia: Real Estate Opportunities — Heading + Description

DarGlobal’s expansion into Saudi Arabia to benefit from growing international interest in the Kingdom’s real estate market

**13 November 2023** – Dar Global, the luxury international real estate developer, is pleased to announce that it is strategically expanding its geographical presence to include Saudi Arabia given several promising opportunities that have been presented and which are currently being evaluated by the management team. The Group will continue to focus on its strategy of delivering high-end, bespoke investment opportunities to affluent and internationally mobile customers.

The Group has grown its portfolio from one property development in 2017 to its current 11 active projects in the UK, Spain, UAE, Oman, Qatar and Bosnia. The Group’s current portfolio GDV stands at US$5.0 billion (as of 30 June 2023).

One of the key drivers of the expansion is the Kingdom’s Vision 2030 plan to diversify its economy away from being a largely energy-based one. As part of this plan, Saudi Arabia is undertaking giga projects in the real estate and hospitality sectors on an unprecedented scale, these projects aim to attract the affluent international clientele and build global appeal in the Kingdom.

title: DarGlobal's Expansion into Saudi Arabia: Real Estate Opportunities
text:
# DarGlobal's Expansion into Saudi Arabia: Real Estate Opportunities — Description

The Group will also benefit from its parent company, Dar Al Arkan’s, established presence in Saudi Arabia with a 29-year track record of delivering high quality real estate projects in the Kingdom. While Dar Al Arkan will remain focused on a domestic customer base, Dar Global will be able to leverage Dar Al Arkan’s significant Saudi market knowledge and local relationships, in areas such as planning, development and construction.

Dar Global will use a similar business model to that used in other international markets, differentiating its properties through partnerships with highly desirable luxury brands to develop unique second homes and investment properties for high-net-worth customers, specifically targeting those who are looking to participate in the unprecedented growth expected in the Kingdom over the coming decade.

With the tourism sector set to become a key pillar for the diversification of Saudi Arabia’s economy, the Group also anticipates compelling opportunities to develop hospitality assets, in line with the recent announcement of its ground-breaking partnership with Dolce & Gabbana in the Maldives.

**Commenting on the news, Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global said:**

title: Dar Global Acquires Prime Plot in Jeddah to Develop Landmark Mixed-Use Project
text:
# Dar Global Acquires Prime Plot in Jeddah to Develop Landmark Mixed-Use Project — Heading + Description

DarGlobal acquires prime plot in Jeddah to develop landmark branded mixed-use scheme

Dar Global, the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has announced the acquisition of a prime 28,800 sqm plot within one of Jeddah’s most forward-thinking masterplans in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. On this site, Dar Global will develop a mixed-use project featuring premium residences, serviced apartments, retail, and offices, in what will be a key addition to Jeddah’s ongoing transformation.

The project supports Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 by contributing to the country’s evolving urban landscape with internationally benchmarked design and architecture - enhancing Jeddah’s appeal as a destination for investment, business, and modern living.

Commenting on the acquisition, Dar Global CEO, Ziad El Chaar, said: “As a company whose roots are in Saudi Arabia and now stands at the heart of international luxury development, this acquisition represents more than just the first steps of a new project development. Indeed, it reinforces our commitment to the country’s bold future. By bringing together Saudi expertise in design and development with global standards of delivery, we aim to create a landmark destination in the heart of Jeddah.”

title: DarGlobal appoints China Tiesiju Civil Engineering Group Co. LTD as the main contractor for DG1 project in Business Bay, Dubai
text:
# DarGlobal appoints China Tiesiju Civil Engineering Group Co. LTD as the main contractor for DG1 project in Business Bay, Dubai — Heading + Description

DarGlobal appoints China Tiesiju Civil Engineering Group Co. LTD as the main contractor for DG1 project in Business Bay, Dubai

**Dubai, UAE; 3 October, 2024:** Following the completion of enabling works, DarGlobal, the international luxury real estate developer, has appointed of China Tiesiju Civil Engineering Group Co. Ltd as the main works contractor for the complete construction operations of its debut bespoke luxury residence DG1, located on the Dubai Canal in the heart of Business Bay. The AED 200 million contract covers the construction of the 20-storey tower comprising 221 units, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments.

With vast experience in executing complex projects globally, the Dubai branch of China Tiesiju Civil Engineering Group Co. Ltd brings a proven track record of delivering large-scale developments on time and with impeccable quality, reinforcing DarGlobal’s commitment to setting new benchmarks in Dubai’s luxury real estate market.

The appointment of China Tiesiju Civil Engineering Group Co. Ltd as the main works contractor follows on from the shoring, excavation, and piling works contract awarded to Stromek Emirates Foundations in November last year. The DG1 project is scheduled for completion in 2026.

[DarGlobal](https://darglobal.co.uk/), the London-listed luxury real estate developer, has appointed M/s ENE Construccion Amaz SL as the main works contractor for Tierra Viva, its signature residential project nestled in the hills of Benahavís on Spain’s Costa del Sol.

The appointment marks the start of full-scale construction on one of Southern Europe’s most exclusive villa communities, with architectural design inspired by the iconic Automobili Lamborghini.

[Tierra Viva](https://darglobal.co.uk/tierra-viva) is a private gated enclave comprising a limited collection of [ultra-luxury villas](https://darglobal.co.uk/tierra-viva), each positioned at a unique elevation to capture uninterrupted views of the Mediterranean Sea. Located just minutes from Marbella, the development combines bold architectural language with a refined lifestyle offering, echoing the precision, performance, and power long associated with the Lamborghini name.

Each villa, ranging from 4 to 6 bedrooms and spanning up to 1,450 sqm, is meticulously designed to offer a seamless indoor-outdoor experience, featuring private pools, saunas, car lifts, and expansive terraces.

title: DAR Global Appoints Rothschild & Co to Explore Growth Opportunities
text:
# DAR Global Appoints Rothschild & Co to Explore Growth Opportunities — Heading + Description

DarGlobal Appoints Rothschild & co to Explore Further Growth Opportunities in London and Saudi Arabia Markets

**20 August 2024:** Dar Global, the London-listed luxury international real estate developer, is pleased to announce the appointment of Rothschild & Co, the leading global independent financial advisor, to explore further growth opportunities in the London and Saudi Arabia markets. The move is part of Dar Global’s strategic plan to expand its presence in the two markets.

While the London market remains a key focus area for Dar Global, the company announced in November 2023 its intention to explore opportunities to expand into Saudi Arabia, to benefit from the growing international interest in the Kingdom. Dar Global will be assisted by its major shareholder Dar Al Arkan in Acquisitions and Joint Ventures within the Saudi market. Dar Global has enjoyed significant prior success in similar transactions across its portfolios, partnering with landowners, government organizations and some of the world’s leading luxury and hospitality brands to deliver high-end, bespoke investment opportunities to affluent and internationally mobile customers.

title: DAR Global Appoints Rothschild & Co to Explore Growth Opportunities
text:
# DAR Global Appoints Rothschild & Co to Explore Growth Opportunities — Description

**Ziad El Chaar, CEO of Dar Global,**said: "Our partnerships are key to our success and our deep-rooted commitment to delivering high-end bespoke investment opportunities for our clients will stand us in good stead as we forge ahead. We look forward to further enhancing our presence in the key London market even as we work alongside our major shareholder Dar Al Arkan to consolidate our acquisitions and joint ventures in the Saudi market. We are pleased to be working with the Rothschild & Co team on advancing our ambitions as we reinforce our brand presence in the region.”

Dar Global expects to publish its half yearly results up to 30 June 2024, on 26 September 2024.
